capabilities: Copy Dataview inline field values into frontmatter properties
Evaluate DQL and DataviewJS queries before insertion
Synchronize frontmatter automatically on a configurable interval or via a manual command
Clean up frontmatter properties when the corresponding field is removed
Exclude files by path, regex, or frontmatter key
extras: Only string, number and date values are supported in frontmatter; HTML results are converted to markdown, and widgets and functions are skipped.
problem: Dataview inline fields are not stored as frontmatter properties, so their values cannot be used as file metadata without manual copying.

relations.evidence: The Dataview plugin must be installed and activated in your Obsidian vault.
Obsidian Digital Garden for the first version of the Dataview compiler/evaluator.

summary: Plugin that evaluates Dataview inline fields and copies their calculated values into frontmatter properties on a configurable interval.
